# Missing error handling for transactional failures

There is no explicit error handling in persist_compile in case of SQL or transaction failures; it assumes the caller manages transaction scope and failure. If this is not properly controlled, atomicity could be compromised.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/persist.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.persist.persist_compile`
